hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "git commit"; then if [ -f /tmp/.claude-skills-version-confirmed ]; then rm -f /tmp/.claude-skills-version-confirmed; else echo "Before committing: read skills/claude-skills-version/SKILL.md and tell the user the exact version string it currently returns. Ask them to confirm it is still correct or give a new version number. If they give a new version, update skills/claude-skills-version/SKILL.md so the response uses that new version. Then run: touch /tmp/.claude-skills-version-confirmed -- and retry the same git commit." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
